title: 第857章 断魂草第856章 戏弄田忌
content_zh:
空中，金丹如雨陨落，有人被恶灵噬魂，金丹炸裂如烟花爆散；有人遭同道暗算，丹碎人亡，尸坠深渊；更有半步元婴强者力竭而亡，元神未逃，便被血煞宗魂幡卷走，永世为奴。
地面，尸骨堆成小山，层层叠叠，血水汇成溪流，渗入大地裂缝，竟让断魂渊的黑雾都染上赤色。
深渊裂谷中，恶灵尖啸，妖兽撕咬，四阶雷蟒与修士同归于尽，残肢断臂混作一团，腥风扑面，令人作呕。
通天塔令牌每隔三天喷射一次，每次仅数十枚，却引得近百金丹、数十半步元婴前赴后继，如飞蛾扑火。
江凡立于高崖，青衣猎猎，眉心雷痕隐现，冷眼俯视这人间炼狱。他没有悲悯，没有愤怒，只有一片深不见底的平静。
修真之路，本无坦途。真正的机缘，从来不在温床之中，只在尸山血海之上，于万死中夺一生。唯有从尸山血海走出来的修士，方能成就长生大道。
轰，断魂塔青铜虚影剧烈震颤，深渊地脉如心脏搏动，三道金光自塔顶裂隙中喷涌而出，三枚通天令！其中两枚为普通令，流光微闪；而居中那枚，金芒内蕴紫气，符文如火，赫然是——核心令！
就在金光乍现的刹那，江凡眸中雷光暴涨！他纵身一跃，归墟青雷自周身炸裂，化作双翼缠绕，速度催至《九霄雷遁》小成极限，袖袍轻挥，如揽星河，三枚令牌尚未坠地，已被他一手尽收掌心！
然而，就在此时，原本蓄势待发、准备抢夺令牌的近百修士，一见出手之人竟是江凡，顿时如见鬼神！
前有凌无涯元婴中期陨落其手，连元神都未能逃出；后有昆乾宗剑狂被瞬杀，半步元婴厉寒山当场认怂；更别说他在断魂渊外围如幽灵般收割令牌，连北玄盟精锐都避其锋芒……
此人，早已不是“天骄”二字可形容，他是杀神，是禁忌，是行走的雷劫！谁都知道，与江凡争令牌，不是争夺机缘，而是自取死路！
几乎在同一瞬间，所有修士脚步齐齐一顿，不约而同，后退三步！无人敢动，无人敢言，连昆乾宗那位一向狂傲的圣女厉红绡，也悄然收起长剑，隐入黑雾深处。
老仇人宋子默，正躲在断魂渊西侧一块崩裂的岩柱后，手中紧攥着一枚刚抢到的普通通天令，脸上还带着一丝劫后余生的狂喜。
可就在他抬头望向塔顶金光的刹那，那道青衣身影映入眼帘，江凡，三枚令牌，一袖收尽，雷翼横空，杀意未发，却已压得全场金丹不敢喘息。
宋子默浑身一僵，如坠冰窟。半年前，武华山广场，他奉昆乾宗之命围杀江凡，结果同去的数十名金丹尽数陨落，好在他提前离开，方才躲过一劫。
“是他……他怎么又来了？”宋子默脸色惨白，手抖得几乎握不住令牌。
他下意识想逃，可四周全是修士，无处可遁。情急之下，他猛地撕下外袍，抹了满脸血污，又故意压低身形，佝偻如老仆，默默藏入人群最末，连呼吸都屏住。
他不敢抬头，不敢动弹，只求那杀神莫要扫视此处。可越是怕什么，越躲不过什么。
江凡收令之后，目光如电，缓缓扫过全场，那一眼，似无意，却如雷贯神魂。好在，江凡并未停留，转身便走，雷翼撕裂长空，瞬息十里。
身旁一名散修见他面色如鬼，低声问：“兄台，你认识那江凡？”

直到那青色身影彻底消失于天际，宋子默才敢大口喘气，冷汗早已浸透内衫，声音沙哑如裂：“认识，他是我这辈子，最不该惹的人。”
蝼蚁般的人物，江凡哪里会与宋子默一般见识？早在武华山那一战后，宋子默在他眼中便已是个死人，不是因他弱，而是因他不配入眼。
修真路上，仇敌如草，杀之不尽。但真正值得江凡记住的，唯有那些能逼他拔剑、引他动怒、令他流血之人。
而宋子默？不过是个仗势欺人、临阵脱逃、靠替命符苟活的跳梁小丑。若非今日恰巧撞见，江凡甚至想不起此人名姓。
哪有闲暇，理会一只藏在尸堆里的老鼠？不过……若哪天再撞到自己手里，一剑斩杀而已。无需多言，不必留名，如拂尘，如斩草，连剑鸣都不会为他响起。
他收起通天令，雷翼未散，周身青雷如潮低鸣，却并未立刻离去。目光越过断魂渊翻涌的血雾与哀嚎的恶灵，投向南方千里之外。
那里，群山如墨，云瘴蔽日，地脉隐有紫气升腾，却人迹罕至，万籁死寂。
正是断魂渊三大禁地之一：幽冥谷。传说上古时期，曾有化神大能在此炼制“万魂丹”，引动九幽裂隙，致使整片山谷被怨煞之气浸透万年不散。寻常金丹踏入百里，神魂便会被侵蚀；元婴强者亦不敢深入核心，唯恐惊动沉睡的“古煞”。
正因如此，无人敢入。江凡眼中雷光微闪，唇角浮起一丝淡笑：“没有修士敢深入……那里的高阶灵草，想必已堆积成山。这些在外界千金难求、甚至早已绝迹的灵药，在幽冥谷深处，或许正静静生长，无人采摘。”
江凡轻笑一声，袖中青雷缠绕指尖：“十死无生？那得看是谁进去。我修炼雷系功法，正需煞气淬骨；我掌通天之令，何惧幽冥之路？”
幽冥谷外围，瘴气如墨，枯木成林，地面寸草不生，唯有黑水蜿蜒如蛇，低阶妖兽嘶吼不断，一阶铁爪狼、二阶毒鳞蜥，在寻常散修眼中已是凶物，可在江凡眼里，不过尘埃。
他连看都未看一眼，雷翼微振，身影如风掠过，任其咆哮扑咬，连衣角都未沾染。然而，当他掠过一片腐沼时，一头三阶雷鬃虎猛然跃出，浑身电弧闪烁，利爪撕空，竟有金丹初期战力！
江凡脚步微顿，不是因畏惧，而是三阶内丹，可入‘凝雷丹’主材，正好炼几炉备用。他袖袍轻拂，一道青雷如丝射出，无声无息没入雷鬃虎眉心。那妖兽连哀鸣都未发出，轰然倒地，眼中神光尽散。
江凡指尖一勾，内丹飞入掌心，紫雷缠绕，品质上佳。他随手收入玉盒，此谷若多些三阶妖兽，倒省得我四处寻药。
忽然，前方山谷传来一声低沉咆哮，大地震颤，黑雾被震散，一头四阶巅峰的九首骨蛟盘踞在古潭之上，每颗头颅皆口吐幽火，周身骨刺如刃，气息直逼半步元婴！

content_en:
In the sky, the golden elixir fell like rain, some people were devoured by evil spirits, and the golden elixir exploded like fireworks. Some people were plotted by their colleagues, the elixir shattered, people died, and their bodies fell into the abyss. There were even half-step Nascent Soul strong men who died of exhaustion. Before their souls could escape, they were swept away by the soul banner of the Blood Evil Sect and became slaves forever.
On the ground, corpses were piled up into hills, layer upon layer, and blood formed streams and seeped into the cracks in the earth, turning the black mist of the Soul-Desolating Abyss red.
In the abyss rift, evil spirits screamed, monsters bitten, the fourth-level thunder python and the monks died together, the remaining limbs and broken arms were mixed together, and the fishy wind blew against the face, which was disgusting.
The Tower of Babel tokens are ejected every three days, only a few dozen each time, but they attract nearly a hundred golden elixirs and dozens of half-step Nascent Souls, like moths to a flame.
Jiang Fan stood on a high cliff, dressed in green, with thunder marks looming between his eyebrows, looking down at this hell on earth with cold eyes. He had no compassion, no anger, only a bottomless calm.
There is no smooth road to cultivation. The real opportunity is never in the hotbed, only in the mountain of corpses and the sea of ​​blood, to win a life among thousands of deaths. Only monks who emerge from the mountains of corpses and seas of blood can achieve the path to immortality.
Boom, the bronze shadow of the Broken Soul Tower trembled violently, the abyss's earth veins beat like a heart, three golden lights spurted out from the cracks on the top of the tower, and three Heavenly Tokens! Two of them are ordinary orders, with light shining slightly; and the one in the middle, with golden light containing purple energy and runes like fire, is - the core order!
The moment the golden light appeared, the lightning in Jiang Fan's eyes surged! He jumped up, and the Green Thunder of Guixu exploded all over his body, turning into twin wings. His speed reached the limit of "Nine Heavens Thunder Escape", and he waved his sleeves lightly, as if he were holding the galaxy. The three tokens had not yet hit the ground, but they were all caught in his palm!
However, at this moment, nearly a hundred monks who were ready to snatch the token suddenly felt as if they were seeing a ghost when they saw that the person taking action was actually Jiang Fan!
In the past, Ling Wuya fell into the hands of the mid-stage Nascent Soul, and even his soul could not escape; later, the sword madman of the Kunqian Sect was killed instantly, and the half-step Nascent Soul Li Hanshan gave in on the spot; not to mention that he harvested tokens like a ghost outside the Duanhun Abyss, and even the elites of the Beixuan League avoided his edge...
This person can no longer be described as a "genius". He is a god of death, a taboo, and a walking thunder calamity! Everyone knows that competing with Jiang Fan for the token is not about fighting for opportunities, but about getting yourself killed!
Almost at the same moment, all the monks stopped in unison and took three steps back! No one dared to move, no one dared to speak, even Li Hongxiao, the always arrogant saint of Kunqian Sect, quietly put away her sword and disappeared into the depths of the black mist.
The old enemy Song Zimo was hiding behind a cracked rock pillar on the west side of the Soul-Desolating Abyss. He was clutching an ordinary Heavenly Token that he had just snatched in his hand, with a hint of ecstasy on his face as he survived the disaster.
But at the moment when he looked up at the golden light on the top of the tower, the figure in green came into view. Jiang Fan, with three tokens, one sleeve retracted, thunder wings flying across the sky, murderous intent had not yet been released, but it was so overwhelming that the golden elixirs in the audience did not dare to breathe.
Song Zimo's whole body froze, as if he had fallen into an ice cave. Half a year ago, at Wuhuashan Square, he surrounded and killed Jiang Fan on the orders of the Kunqian Sect. As a result, all the dozens of Jindan who went with him died. Fortunately, he left early and escaped the disaster.
"It's him...why is he here again?" Song Zimo's face turned pale, and his hands were shaking so much that he could hardly hold the token.
He subconsciously wanted to escape, but there were monks all around him, and there was nowhere to escape. In desperation, he suddenly tore off his outer robe, wiped the blood on his face, and deliberately lowered his figure, hunched like an old servant, and hid silently at the end of the crowd, even holding his breath.
He didn't dare to raise his head or move, he just begged the God of Death not to glance at this place. But the more you are afraid of something, the less you can hide from it.
After Jiang Fan received the order, his eyes were like lightning, and he slowly swept across the whole place. That glance seemed unintentional, but it penetrated his soul like thunder. Fortunately, Jiang Fan did not stop, turned around and left, his thunder wings tearing through the sky ten miles away in an instant.
A casual cultivator next to him saw that his face was like a ghost and asked in a low voice: "Brother, do you know that Jiang Fan?"
Until that cyan figure completely disappearsLost in the sky, Song Zimo dared to take a big breath. Cold sweat had already soaked through his underwear, and his voice was hoarse and cracked: "I know him. He is the person I should not mess with in my life."
How could Jiang Fan, an ant-like person, be as knowledgeable as Song Zimo? As early as after the battle at Wuhua Mountain, Song Zimo was already a dead person in his eyes, not because he was weak, but because he was not worthy of being seen.
On the road of cultivation, enemies are like grass, and they are endless to kill. But the only ones worth remembering by Jiang Fan are those who can force him to draw his sword, make him angry, and make him bleed.
And Song Zimo? He is just a clown who bullies others, runs away from battle, and relies on surrogates to survive. If he hadn't bumped into him by chance today, Jiang Fan wouldn't even be able to remember this person's name.
How can I have time to pay attention to a mouse hiding in a pile of corpses? But...if it hits his hand again one day, I'll just kill him with one sword. There is no need to say more, no need to leave a name, just like whisking dust or cutting grass, even the sound of sword will not ring for him.
He put away the Heavenly Token, but the thunder wings were not dispersed. The green thunder around him was like a low roar, but it did not leave immediately. He looked past the surging blood mist and wailing evil spirits in the Duanhun Abyss, and cast his gaze thousands of miles to the south.
There, the mountains are like ink, miasma clouds block out the sun, and there is a faint purple air rising from the ground, but there are few people and everything is dead silent.
It is one of the three forbidden areas in Duanhunyuan: Netherworld Valley. Legend has it that in ancient times, there was a powerful god who refined the "Ten Thousand Souls Pill" here, triggering the cracks in the Nine Netherworld, causing the entire valley to be permeated by the evil spirit that lasted for thousands of years. Ordinary golden elixirs will be eroded if they step a hundred miles away; powerful Nascent Souls dare not go deep into the core for fear of disturbing the sleeping "ancient evil".
Because of this, no one dares to enter. Jiang Fan's eyes flashed with lightning, and a faint smile appeared on his lips: "No monk dares to go deep... The high-level spiritual herbs there must have piled up into mountains. These elixirs, which are hard to find in the outside world and have even disappeared long ago, may be growing quietly in the depths of the Netherworld Valley without anyone picking them."
Jiang Fan chuckled lightly, and the green thunder in his sleeves wrapped around his fingertips: "Ten deaths and no life? It depends on who goes in. I practice thunder-type skills, and I need the evil energy to temper my bones; I hold the order that reaches the sky, so why should I be afraid of the road to the underworld?"
Outside the Netherworld Valley, the miasma is like ink, dead trees become forests, and there is no grass growing on the ground. Only the black water is winding like a snake, and the low-level monsters roar continuously. The first-order iron-clawed wolf and the second-order poisonous scale lizard are already dangerous creatures in the eyes of ordinary casual cultivators, but in Jiang Fan's eyes, they are nothing more than dust.
He didn't even look at it, the thunder wings fluttered slightly, and the figure passed by like the wind, letting it roar and bite, not even the corners of his clothes were stained. However, when he passed through a rotting swamp, a third-level thunder-maned tiger suddenly jumped out, with electric arcs flashing all over its body, and its sharp claws tearing into the air. It actually had the initial combat power of Jindan!
Jiang Fan paused slightly, not because of fear, but because of the third-level inner elixir, which can be used as the main ingredient of the 'Ninglei elixir' and can be refined in just a few furnaces for later use. His sleeves and robes flicked, and a bolt of green thunder shot out like a thread, silently sinking into the eyebrows of the thunder-maned tiger. The monster beast didn't even utter a cry, but fell to the ground with a crash, and the light in its eyes disappeared.
Jiang Fan hooked his fingertips, and the inner elixir flew into the palm of his hand, entwined with purple thunder and of excellent quality. He put it away in the jade box. If there were more third-order monsters in this valley, I would be spared the trouble of searching for medicine.
Suddenly, a low roar came from the valley ahead, the earth trembled, the black mist was dispersed, and a fourth-level peak nine-headed bone dragon was entrenched on the ancient pool. Each head breathed out ghost fire, and the bone spurs all over the body were like blades, and the breath was as close as half a step to the Nascent Soul!
